name: PunisherWatchlist
description: Adds eye buttons to movies, series, and episodes plus a personal Watchlist tab on the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Replaces the custom Watchlist grid and hover implementation with Jellyfin Web 12.1's native Favorites view. Watchlist IDs are supplied to Jellyfin's own Favorites sections, cards, responsive layout, metadata, badges, hover menus, and standard actions for identical behavior on desktop and mobile.
